glosses: continual, constant (done or extending without interruption)
continuous, adjacent (extending from one to another without interruption)
steady, persevering (continuing with one's task without interruption)

examples.text: El cerebro necesita un suministro continuo de sangre.
examples.en: The brain needs a continuous supply of blood.

examples.text: Estoy harto de sus continuas quejas.
examples.en: I'm fed up with her grumbling.

examples.text: Tom dio su palabra sobre su continuo apoyo.
Interrumpía al ponente con preguntas continuas.
examples.en: He interrupted the speaker with frequent questions.
